newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile awards beryl ore, but no antimony.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile awards beryl ore, but no antimony.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center said it awarded 2,000 short tons of beryl ore for an approximate market value of $400,000 to Mulege International, and has now exhausted the amount available in the present fiscal year.
The Stockpile said it made no awards for antimony or cadmium in the recent offering opened on December 10.
The next bids for antimony and cadmium will be received on January 14, 1997.
